context: An expanding real-estate company's latest filing shows debt-to-equity has tripled to 3x in a year, with interest coverage down to 1.4x, funding five simultaneous projects. The same week, headlines called the expansion 'transformational.'

block.question: Given only what you can see, is the risk here skewed to the downside, upside, or roughly balanced?
block.factorQuestion: Which of these support that read?

factorOptions.label: Debt-to-equity has tripled in a year
Interest coverage has fallen to 1.4x, leaving little room for a bad quarter
Analysts are calling it a transformational expansion
The stock price has risen since the expansion was announced
